India's Fiscal Deficit Reaches 26.8% of Annual Target in April-July

India's fiscal deficit stood at 26.8% of the annual target during the April-July period. This figure represents the government's revenue shortfall relative to its spending commitments for the fiscal year. The data indicates the pace at which the deficit is accumulating against the yearly goal.
